name: Physical Access Roster and Review Record
description: The population of people holding physical access to facilities and sensitive areas, the periodic review of that population, and the revocation records resulting from it.

expected_content.element: Complete roster of badge or credential holders with the areas each may enter
expected_content.why: Establishes the population; general facility access and server room access must be distinguishable.

expected_content.element: Statement of how the roster was generated from the access control system
expected_content.why: Population completeness is assessed before any sample is drawn.

expected_content.element: Reviewer identity, review date, and per-holder decision
expected_content.why: Distinguishes a review from an acknowledgement of a list.

expected_content.element: Revocation records for holders identified as no longer requiring access, with the date effected
expected_content.why: Follow-through is what makes the review a control rather than an inventory.

expected_content.element: Reconciliation of the roster against current personnel records
expected_content.why: Former personnel retaining badge access is the single most common failure of this control.

expected_content.element: Treatment of contractors, visitors, and maintenance personnel, including escort requirements
expected_content.why: These populations are commonly outside the badge system and therefore outside the review.
Supports the control where escorted access to server rooms is claimed.

source_system_examples: Badge access control system cardholder report

freshness_expectation.rationale: DriftGuard default of one quarterly cadence plus a 30-day grace window. Not an audit rule.

redaction_guidance: Badge numbers and personal identifiers may be tokenised provided reconciliation to personnel records remains possible.
Do not include home addresses or other personnel data that the roster export may carry.
retention_guidance: Retain roster snapshots and review records for the examination period plus the following period.

validation_rules.rule: A roster review record exists for each scheduled review in the period.
The roster reconciles to current personnel records with differences explained.
Holders identified for removal have revocation records showing the access was actually withdrawn.
Badge revocation for terminated personnel occurred within the entity's committed timeframe.
The facilities covered are those holding protected information assets or endpoints with access to them.
The roster is exported from the access control system rather than maintained as a separate spreadsheet.

common_issues.issue: Badge access remains active for terminated personnel because physical and logical deprovisioning are separate processes.
common_issues.impact: Physical entry remains possible after the authorisation basis ended.

common_issues.issue: A single roster covers all areas, so server room access cannot be distinguished from office access.
common_issues.impact: Least privilege for sensitive areas cannot be assessed.

common_issues.issue: Contractors hold badges issued outside the standard process and are absent from the review population.
common_issues.impact: A population with physical access is never reviewed.

source_refs.supports: Expected content, persuasiveness weighting, and the common issues list.
Freshness window, sensitivity classification, and redaction guidance.

notes: Where an entity holds no facilities of its own, this artifact does not apply and EV-PHYSEC-002 carries CC6.4 instead. That is a scoping outcome, not a missing control.
